title: 关羽斩华雄传记
prompt:
Edit the supplied 1536x1024 image in one integrated revision, not a new illustration. Preserve background, continuous dragon, Guan Yu's airborne main pose/green ornate armor, and wide-bellied crescent blade on one perfectly straight pole.
CRITICAL: COMPLETELY REDRAW HUA XIONG'S UPPER BODY AT A NEW SIMPLE 3/4 FRONT-SIDE ANGLE, not a correction layered over the old contorted torso. The old mirrored biceps pose is anatomically unconvincing. Erase the old shoulders, arms and hands. Rebuild a robust grounded man in lower-right, chest turned three-quarters toward upper-left attacker, spine upright leaning forward in resistance rather than arched backward. Near shoulder larger and forward, far shoulder smaller and behind on ONE coherent shoulder plane. Both shoulders, elbows, wrists and palms obey this same camera perspective and torso orientation. The near arm has a clearly bent elbow beside his ribs with forearm rising diagonally in front of chest; the far arm reaches forward/up on the far side, visibly foreshortened, NOT mirrored. Both hands grip the SAME straight brown saber handle together above/in front of his left-facing head, hands spaced naturally behind guard. The broad single steel saber extends up-left to physically block Guan Yu's descending crescent belly at one real edge-contact point. Exactly TWO shoulders, TWO arms, TWO elbows, TWO wrists, TWO hands. Each arm is traceable from its own shoulder to grip. No detached shoulder pads, no extra skin bulge, no old arm remnants or duplicated hand. Keep Hua Xiong's wild loose hair, rugged broad western-warrior face and massive build, heavy dark red armor, no Lu Bu crown/plumes. Adjust his hips/legs locally if needed for believable braced weight and coherent perspective, but keep him in lower-right and leave the duel's overall layout.
Adjust his saber and the physical contact position naturally to the new torso/arm pose. Exactly one thick-backed saber and one Guan Yu crescent glaive. Strong directional green blade energy follows Guan Yu's downward-right stroke; actual steel collision remains visible, do not bridge disconnected blades with sparks.
Guan Yu's face: composed decisive warrior concentration, pupils FIXED on Hua Xiong below-right, slight tension in brow and eyes without distortions or grimacing; same mature identity.
Small lower-left onlookers: FREEZE seated Cao Cao holding wine cup and standing Liu Bei, both faces, shapes, clothing, poses exactly unchanged. ONLY repaint Zhang Fei (leftmost standing big bearded man): deep Shu-green/dark forest-green warrior armor, wild thick eyebrows, large round fierce eyes, broad coarse leopard-like face and bushy beard, formidable rough general, NOT refined scholar. Keep his scale and position.
Preserve gate plaque text 汜水關. No other text, frames, UI. Mythic dimensional manga illustration. This revision's priority is a genuinely DIFFERENT SIMPLE HUA XIONG UPPER BODY VIEW with shared consistent perspective, not merely counting hands in the old pose.

qa.perspective: Personally inspected 2x torso crop, not just hand count. Hua Xiong torso replaced with upright braced front-three-quarter view. Image-right near shoulder emerges behind fur armor, upper arm descends to elbow beside ribs, forearm rises inward to rear hand near chest. Image-left far shoulder lies behind torso edge, upper arm projects forward-left toward foreshortened elbow, forearm rises to forward hand behind guard. Both chains share chest orientation and grip same diagonal handle. No mirrored over-head biceps or backward torso twist. Two hands and no spare limb identified.
qa.contact: Single saber physically meets wide-bellied crescent near (1025,600). Straight Guan Yu pole and blade root retained.
qa.face: Guan Yu narrowed decisive downward-right gaze; mature features intact.
qa.observers: Cao Cao seated wine-cup pose and Liu Bei armor retained visually. Zhang Fei now deep green armor, thick brows rough broad face; round-eye exaggeration modest.
caveats: Small figures' facial features remain stylized and limited by pixel size.
Dragon remains source composition, no further structural edits this round.
